description: NaCaYWO₆ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic F̅43m space group. Na is bonded to twelve equivalent O atoms to form NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent CaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent YO₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent WO₆ octahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.94 Å. Ca is bonded to twelve equivalent O atoms to form CaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent CaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent YO₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent WO₆ octahedra. All Ca-O bond lengths are 2.94 Å. Y is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form YO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent WO₆ octahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four equivalent CaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Y-O bond lengths are 2.21 Å. W is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form WO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent YO₆ octahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four equivalent CaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All W-O bond lengths are 1.94 Å. O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Ca, one Y, and one W atom.
